==== Escanor ====
Voiced by: Tomokazu Sugita, Sara Matsumoto (young)  (Japanese); Kyle Hebert, Kira Buckland (young) (English)
Escanor (エスカノール, Esukanōru) is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins who bears the Lion Sin of Pride, symbolized by a lion on his back. Born a prince of the Kingdom of Tarim,[vol. 39:The King Sings Alone] he was disowned and driven from his homeland due to his inability to control his monstrous strength, with his maid Rosa helping him escape via the sea in a barrel.[ch. 169] He traveled in solitude due to being feared before being recruited as the final member of the Seven Deadly Sins, who made him feel welcome as he fell in love with Merlin and later played a role in devastating Edinburgh Castle during the Deadly Sins' battle with the vampires. Following the group's disbandment 10 years ago, Escanor opened a secret tavern in a mountain cave where he remains until Ban finds him by accident, at which point he rejoins the Deadly Sins. 
Despite his usual scrawny appearance, Escanor possesses Sunshine (太陽（サンシャイン）, Sanshain), which is later revealed to be the lost Grace of the Archangel Mael. It enhances Escanor's physique during the day before reaching his full power for one minute at noon when the sun is at its zenith, exceeding every living being on the planet as power incarnate known as "The One" (天上天下唯我独尊（ザ・ワン）, Za Wan). It also causes Escanor's body to radiate immense heat that he can store in his Sacred Treasure Sacred Axe Ritta (神斧リッタ, Jinpu Ritta), a massive, ornate one-handed axe with a crescent blade.[ch. 170] But continued use of Sunshine gradually damages Escanor's body, eventually reducing him to ashes in the aftermath of the group's final battle against the Demon King.[ch. 253] But, the events of Four Knights of the Apocalypse reveal that Merlin revived Escanor in an artificial body with Gawain being their biological daughter. Escanor came in twenty-eighth place in a 2014 character popularity poll for the series.

Section: Abilities and Equipment > Abilities
Link text: Sunshine
Parent passage: Sunshine「太陽サンシャイン, Sanshain; lit. "Sun"」: Escanor's ability is one of duality. He is weakest at midnight, but starting from dawn his power level begins to rise steadily from one hour to the next until it peaks at noon. During his fight with Galand, his power level was shown increasing by 5 points with seemingly every second and was measured at 50,060 while continuing to rise. At his peak, according to Merlin, he easily surpasses any of the other Sins. This cycle is marked by distinct differences in his abilities, personality and appearance.

Ownership and period limit: the parent lists this technique in the section above. Former, evolved or absorbed entries do not establish current availability. The shared technique description below does not transfer other users' powers to this character.

Sunshine: Sunshine「太陽サンシャイン, Sanshain; lit. "Sun"」 is one of the four Graces created by the Supreme Deity.

Sunshine: Originally, it was given to Mael of the Four Archangels. After Gowther used a forbidden spell to turn Mael into Estarossa, the Grace was abandoned for 3,000 years until it found its new host - Escanor.

Sunshine: During the New Holy War, Mael allies with the Seven Deadly Sins and Escanor returns the Grace to him so he could protect his friends. Mael later would give Sunshine back to Escanor for him to fight the Demon King, remaining with him until his death after the battle.

Sunshine: Escanor's Magical Power is said to be unlike any other. Starting from sunrise, his power begins to increase and he grows larger and his personality changes from his submissive night-self to his prideful daytime-self, with the process reversing with the setting of the sun. Merlin hearkens his Power to that of the actual sun, the source of all life.

Sunshine: In the daytime, Escanor's size and musculature grows considerably, becoming many times his own size. His physical strength increases dramatically as he was able to split Galand in two with a sigle attack. He is able to radiate intense waves of light and heat easily capable of melting metal and vaporizing stone. He can even create miniature suns, whose heat is such that it can melt the armor of a Holy Knight several meters away just by being in its vicinity. It can also be controlled and directed for attacks, causing immense damage. Escanor is able to imbue Rhitta with his magic, which causes the slashes from his axe to also burn his foes.

Sunshine: At high noon, Escanor reaches his absolute peak and becomes The One, "the invincible incarnation of power", according to Merlin. This form only lasts for one minute. While in this form, Escanor's strength increases to the point where with a single strike of his hand, he could knock off Meliodas in his Assault Mode. His durability also grew to the point where he could easily shrug off Meliodas' Kami Chigiri without sustaining any damage. He was also able to eventually overcome Zeldris' Ominous Nebula attraction force, whereas previously powerless to resist it, leaving Chandler and Cusack shocked and Zeldris referring to Escanor as a monster.

Sunshine: However, as Sunshine is made for an Archangel of the Goddess Clan, Escanor cannot resist the effects of using it on his human body, damaging him to the point of coughing blood and finally eating away his body.

Sunshine: Cruel Sun「無慈悲な太陽クルーエル・サン, Kurūeru San; lit. "Merciless Sun"」: Escanor creates a miniature Sun, which radiates so much heat that it melts nearby armor. He can control it with hand gestures and strike his opponents with it, and it will increase in size.

Sunshine: Pride Flare「炸裂する傲慢プライド・フレア, Puraido Furea; lit. "Exploding Arrogance"」: Escanor causes his Cruel Sun to flare with heat so intense it is capable of vaporizing a sizable lake in an instant.

Sunshine: Crazy Prominence「爆発する矜持クレイジー・プロミネンス, Kureijī Purominensu; lit. "Exploding Arrogance"」: Escanor produces a large amount of miniature suns from his body that explode on impact.

Sunshine: Final Prominence「終末の業火ファイナルプロミネンス, Fainaru Purominensu; lit. "Doomsday’s Hellfire"」: As The One: Ultimate, Escanor concentrates all of his power into a gigantic swirling fireball that he hurls at the opponent.

Link text: Rhitta
Parent passage: Rhitta: A giant, ornamental axe, named after a maiden said to be loved by the Sun. It is incredibly heavy and most of its weight is concentrated on the head, which makes it very off-balanced yet, during the day, Escanor is able to wield it with one hand.

Ownership and period limit: the parent lists this technique in the section above. Former, evolved or absorbed entries do not establish current availability. The shared technique description below does not transfer other users' powers to this character.

Rhitta: The Divine Axe Rhitta「神斧リッタ, Jinpu Ritta」 is a Sacred Treasure that was in the possession of the Lion's Sin of Pride, Escanor.

Rhitta: By saying the command "Sacred Treasure Release"「神じん器ぎ解放かいほう, Jingi Kaihō」, Escanor can release all the power he has stored in Rhitta in an instant. The release is accompanied by an incredible wave of light and heat, illuminating the night sky and causing onlookers to mistake it for the sun itself.

Rhitta: Escanor can call Rhitta to himself at will via the simple command "Heed my will"「我が意思に応えよ, Waga ishi ni kotaeyo」, and the axe will travel at incredible speeds through the sky to reach him.

Rhitta: By having enough stored power, Rhitta also allows Escanor to assume his daytime form at night.

Rhitta: Charge & Fire「充填チャージ＆放射ファイア, Chāji & Faia; lit. "Filling & Radiation"」: Rhitta's special ability is to completely absorb and store the enormous amount of heat Escanor radiates from his body during the day. This allows him to release the heat on command and with precision instead of simply burning away everything in his vicinity.

documents.text:
Escanor「エスカノール」 is the Lion's Sin of Pride「傲慢の罪ライオン・シン, Raion Shin」 of the Seven Deadly Sins, the former second prince of the Kingdom of Castellio, and the man known throughout the Kingdom of Liones as "The Strongest Holy Knight". His Sacred Treasure is the Divine Axe, Rhitta, and his Magical Power is called Sunshine, which made him renowned for gaining immense power during the day, and gradually becoming weaker with the setting of the sun, leaving him frail and submissive at night.

Upon dying after the defeat of the Demon King, Merlin placed Escanor's soul within a magical golem. It was revealed that Escanor is the father of Gawain, as a result of forbidden magic with which Merlin combined the flesh and blood of the two.

Abilities and Equipment
Escanor has been described as the strongest member of the Seven Deadly Sins and considered the single strongest true human, as well as one of the strongest characters overall.

Abilities and Equipment
Upon his fight with Galand and Melascula, two of the Ten Commandments, he easily defeated them when the sun began rising with little effort whereas Ban and Jericho could not do anything against either. Escanor's might is considered monstrous, both by enemy and ally alike. Estarossa, one of the strongest members of the Ten Commandments, refused to believe someone so powerful was a human and was rendered paralyzed in fear of Escanor's might.

Abilities and Equipment
Even Meliodas, the leader of the Sins, has acknowledged Escanor to be far stronger. Merlin also has a lot of faith in his abilities, acknowledging Escanor as the only individual who can stop Meliodas when he reverted to his previous self. True enough, using "The One" Escanor was able to defeat Meliodas in his Assault Mode with a single attack, although it is worth noting that before reaching The One, Escanor was barely capable of holding off Meliodas. At night, however, his power is the weakest due to the setting of the sun, rendering him powerless and unable to use his magic.

Abilities and Equipment
In battle, Escanor primarily relies on the rising of the sun to use his magic, Sunshine for battle. As when the sun rises, his magical power and size grow greatly. Just nearing noon causes his body to emit an enormous amount of heat to the point of being able to melt armor like nothing and incinerate others by being around them. Just using a single attack caused a lake to be evaporated in a flash from the intense heat Escanor gave off. His incredible brute strength increases in conjunction with his magical power, as a single swing from his axe Rhitta upon transforming, was enough to cleave Galand in two and swing it with a single arm whereas Galand has a hard time even moving it with two. Escanor's durability also increases with his magic as his muscles were durable enough to catch Meliodas' weapon when he attacked in Assault Mode and easily brushed off a series of slashes at his peak. Escanor's speed also increases with his magic as he could easily match Meliodas' speed in Assault Mode with his weapon and managed to block various attacks from the notably swift Ludociel with ease.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
Sunshine「太陽サンシャイン, Sanshain; lit. "Sun"」: Escanor's ability is one of duality. He is weakest at midnight, but starting from dawn his power level begins to rise steadily from one hour to the next until it peaks at noon. During his fight with Galand, his power level was shown increasing by 5 points with seemingly every second and was measured at 50,060 while continuing to rise. At his peak, according to Merlin, he easily surpasses any of the other Sins. This cycle is marked by distinct differences in his abilities, personality and appearance.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
Daytime: Beginning with the rising of the Sun at dawn Escanor begins to make a dramatic change, both physically and mentally. He grows much taller and muscular as time passes, with his clothes being ripped off him unless specifically tailored to his growth. In this state, his physical strength and endurance are incredible and his immense magic power casually radiates from his body as intense heat which normally reduces everything around him to ashes. He seems to be able to exert some control over this, being able to prevent friends from being hurt or turning his power up at will to produce intense light and heat capable of melting even stone. In this state, his normally skittish demeanor is replaced by one of confidence and a royal atmosphere.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
Super Slash「微塵斬りスーパースラッシュ, Sūpā Surasshu; lit. "Atomic Slash"」: Escanor delivers a powerful downwards slash with his axe that causes considerable damage that can be felt from several meters away.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
Night-time: With the setting of the Sun, Escanor returns to his original, skittish self. He's seemingly weaker than an average human, and his power level has been measured at 15.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
The One「天上天下唯我独尊ザ・ワン, Za Wan; lit. "Vainglorious Existence across Heaven and Earth"」: During noon, when his power is at its peak, for one minute he becomes the manifestation of power itself and his body dwarfs normal people. In this form, he is said to be invincible.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
Divine Sword Escanor「聖剣せいけんエスカノール, Seiken Esukanōru; lit. "Holy Sword"」: Escanor makes a downward swiping motion with his hand that can cut an opponent. This attack was powerful enough to destroy Zeldris' Ominous Nebula.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
Divine Spear Escanor「聖槍せいそうエスカノール, Seisō Esukanōru; lit. "Holy Spear"」: Escanor thrusts his index finger at his opponent with enough force to pierce them.

Abilities and Equipment
Abilities
The One: Ultimate「“天上天下唯我独尊”ザ・ワンの極みアルティメット, "Za Wan" Arutimetto; lit. Pinnacle of "Vainglorious Existence across Heaven and Earth"」: An extension of Escanor's "The One" form created by Escanor himself. After noon, when "the One" reaches it's limit and begins to fade, Escanor circumvents it by converting his own life force into magic power in order to not only keep "the One" active, but also greatly enhance its already invincible power. This technique is Escanor's last resort and a double-edged sword, as using it will completely burn out his own life force, and eventually kill him.

Abilities and Equipment
Weapons
Rhitta: A giant, ornamental axe, named after a maiden said to be loved by the Sun. It is incredibly heavy and most of its weight is concentrated on the head, which makes it very off-balanced yet, during the day, Escanor is able to wield it with one hand.

Abilities and Equipment
Weapons
Large Spear: A large spear Escanor possessed and was shown with briefly ten years ago before the Seven Deadly Sins were framed for Zaratras' murder. It appears to not be as heavy in comparison to his Sacred Treasure.

Abilities and Equipment
Weapons
Magic Glasses: Given to him recently by Merlin, Escanor is able to suppress his daytime form. However, he will instantly transform into his larger self if they are removed.

Abilities and Equipment
Power Level
Due to his power, Escanor's power level is constantly fluctuating and cannot be accurately measured for an extended period of time. The lowest it has been recorded is 15 (Magic: 5, Strength: 5, and Spirit: 5) during the entirety of the night, and the highest given number it has been recorded is 114,000, shortly before noon.
